image_description: A close-up, angled view of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is primarily silver/grey plastic with a large red and white paper label wrapped around the front face. The label features repeated text 'MAGNETIC TAPE' and '1200ft'. A blue circular hub is visible on the top left spool window. The bottom edge shows the dark magnetic tape strip exposed through the rectangular opening.

The edge definition on the far right is slightly soft and bleeds into the background, lacking the sharp, hard-edge geometry expected of rigid plastic.
